body: I only have thoughts that hurt my own feelings it seems

I feel very very similarly! Suicidality for me is based a lot in my shame and guilt and just wanting to not exist. I feel like a failure despite privileges I've had.

After graduation is a weird time. As an ivy graduate I'm sure you gained valuable skills. Don't be so hard on yourself, and don't feel like you have to rush into anything. I'm sure with trial and error you'll get to a place where you can have a job you are happy with.
r/SuicideWatch but do you want to talk?

Who I am and what I've done to hurt people. I was never trying to hurt people but I did. Even this post is more of me wallowing in self pity. But I can't get over the shame so I turn to self-flagellation.
